description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: Outside the Chinese mainland.
The IDs of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.
The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

description.zh: 标签列表，最多包含20个子项
description.en: The tags to add to the resource.
The key of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
The value of tag N to add to the resource. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.

title.zh: 为指定的资源创建并绑定标签

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --resource-id demo.xxxaliyundoc.com-waf --tag Value=demoTagValue Key=demoTagKey --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'demo.xxxaliyundoc.com-waf' --Tag.1.Key demoTagKey --Tag.1.Value demoTagValue --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
